faq.a1: Yes. ToutPVR runs on your own server or NAS: streams and recordings never leave your network. The portal is only used to validate the licence.
faq.a10: Yes: after cancellation the licence stays active until the end of the paid period, with no automatic renewal.
faq.a2: All RTSP, ONVIF (auto-discovery), HTTP/MJPEG and USB cameras. Most brands on the market are supported.
faq.a3: The server checks the licence online every 24 h and tolerates 7 days offline. Beyond that it switches to restricted mode until the network is back.
faq.a4: A Raspberry Pi 4 is enough for 2 to 4 cameras with motion detection. For full AI on 8+ cameras, prefer an x86 mini PC.
faq.a5: No: detection runs locally with OpenCV (and YOLO when available). No image is ever sent to a third-party service.
faq.a6: Yes, 14 days free on 2 cameras, no credit card required. Upgrading to a paid plan keeps your configuration.
faq.a7: One key is bound to one server. You can release the activation from your customer area to move to another machine at any time.
faq.a8: Yes, at any time from your customer area. The difference is billed through a new order.
faq.a9: Card via Stripe (monthly or yearly). For EU businesses, VAT is reverse-charged with a valid intra-community number.

features.f1.desc: 1/4/9/16 camera wall, full screen, detachable windows, RTSP/ONVIF/USB streams, auto-discovery and PTZ.
features.f1.more: Each camera gets its own pipeline: FPS limiter, sub-stream for analysis and main stream for recording.
features.f1.title: Multi-camera live view
features.f2.desc: People, vehicles, animals, include/exclude zones, virtual lines and time-based intrusions, all on-premises.
features.f2.more: MOG2 motion detector followed by HOG or YOLO classification: you choose the accuracy / resources trade-off.
features.f2.title: Built-in AI
features.f3.desc: Continuous or event-based recording in MP4 segments, 5 s pre-recording, automatic retention and disk quota.
features.f3.more: 24 h timeline per camera, clip export, lock important sequences against purge.
features.f3.title: Smart recording
features.f4.desc: Rules per camera, event type and time range, with cooldown, to e-mail, webhook, Telegram or push.
features.f4.more: Every alert includes the snapshot and the clip; acknowledge it in one click from the panel or your phone.
features.f4.title: Instant alerts
features.f5.desc: Owner/admin/operator/viewer/guest roles, atomic permissions, API keys, audit log and two-factor authentication.
features.f5.more: Manage several sites from a single panel and delegate monitoring without sharing your password.
features.f5.title: Users & permissions
features.f6.desc: Ed25519-signed updates with backup and automatic rollback, encrypted secrets, hardened sessions.
features.f6.more: The server verifies the sha256 and signature of every package before applying it; on failure it rolls back to the previous version.
features.f6.title: Security & updates
features.lead: A complete NVR, designed to be installed in minutes and run without the cloud.
features.title: Everything you need to monitor with peace of mind
